breakdown.description: NPSH available is based on absolute pressure head at the pump suction; neglecting atmospheric pressure for an open reservoir is inconsistent and underpredicts suction pressure head.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Atmospheric pressure should be neglected' and uses the formula NPSHa = -hs - hL - Pv/(rho g), which omits the p_atm/(rho g) term. The ground truth requires including atmospheric pressure (p_atm = 101.3 kPa) in the NPSH formula. The agent repeated the original error.

breakdown.description: Mixing gauge and absolute pressures in NPSH calculations leads to incorrect cavitation margin.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification uses the flawed formula that neglects atmospheric pressure while still using absolute vapor pressure (3.2 kPa), which mixes gauge and absolute pressures. The ground truth resolves this by consistently using absolute pressures with the full formula NPSHa = (p_atm/(rho g)) - hs - hL - (Pv/(rho g)). The agent did not fix this inconsistency.
